R1.description: A stage's round is the Workflow's integer review_round, else, over the stored job pre-states and the current snapshot, whatever the reconcile class or action: implementation is 1 plus the rises of implementation_revision (a gate_reached publication counts, a same_content republication does not) and plan is the distinct plan_revision values observed at a plan-review ready phase, so unpublished authoring rises never count; for the plan stage this is a documented lower bound, since the Workflow counts published contents, which can exceed plan_revision, and the source is reported as jobs; the cap and telemetry share one function; null is never 0

R2.description: review.round_cap (default 4, 1-100, generation 7) and --review-round-cap on step and run exist; the flag wins; a bad value exits 2

R3.description: A protocol step does not launch apply at round >= cap or local review at round > cap; it returns the review_round_cap_reached gate and writes one GATE_BLOCKED record; nothing else is stopped or written

R4.description: explain shows the same gate; raising the cap continues the loop; the legacy path and the loop guard precedence are unchanged

R5.description: telemetry reports and groups action, stage, round and round_source per job (stored, else derived, every derived round, of either stage, labelled ~ and kept apart from the Workflow's) with no job-record change and byte-identical existing text output and additive JSON

R6.description: Pages and roadmap agree with the behaviour; check_docs, golden checks and the full suite are green
